tldr: The full sound-and-complete lag-robust fixing theorem remains open, but the terminating three-way certified procedure now has two imported graph-native success regions in addition to its existing concrete and saturated-ID rules. After the Assaad--Devijver--Gaussier--Gössler--Meynaoui causally sufficient adjustment test, it deterministically checks every nonempty macro-mediator set against Assaad's 2025 four-condition latent-confounded SCG front-door criterion, only for \(\gamma\in\{0,L\}\), and returns the source's explicit nested finite-cylinder functional for the first passing set. The local proof establishes the required full-time-ADMG class inclusion and positivity of every denominator; no necessity or generic-family inclusion is claimed. The verified binary lag-switch pair remains the direct failure certificate, all other undecided inputs return \(\operatorname{UNKNOWN}\), and the conservative transition bound is \(6+2^{n-2}+3^{n\{\gamma+(n-1)L+1\}}\). Every success supports the existing cylinder plug-in and HAC delta-method inference under the stated positivity, mixing, bandwidth, and variance conditions.
gap: The PMLR abstract of Assaad, Devijver, Gaussier, Gössler, and Meynaoui reports necessary-and-sufficient singleton total-effect conditions for SCGs under causal sufficiency and the paper provides adjustment sets; Ferreira--Assaad completely characterize linear direct effects under the same no-hidden-confounding boundary. Assaad's hidden-confounded micro-total-effect theorem supplies one front-door sufficient formula but no generic front-door-class frontier or complete micro-effect decision rule, while Ferreira--Assaad prove completeness only for macro interventions on whole SCG clusters. Jahn--Karnik--Schulman bound ID after the periodic fine graph is known, Jaber and coauthors prove completeness for a fixed finite PAG, and Shpitser--Pearl give functional-or-hedge completeness for one fixed ADMG.
